columns.name: activity_year
columns.description: The year associated with the HMDA loan records; every row in this profile is for 2014.

columns.name: respondent_id
columns.description: An identifier for the reporting respondent or institution, stored as a string. The observed identifiers include both digits-only values and a value with a hyphen.

columns.name: agency_name
columns.description: The name of the agency associated with the record. The profile shows six agency names.
domain_values: Department of Housing and Urban Development
Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

columns.name: agency_abbr
columns.description: The abbreviation of the agency associated with the record, such as HUD, CFPB, or FDIC.

columns.name: agency
columns.description: A numeric agency code; the observed codes map to the agency names in agency_name (for example, 7 is Department of Housing and Urban Development and 9 is Consumer Financial Protection Bureau).

columns.name: loan_type_name
columns.description: The descriptive category for the loan type, with observed values Conventional, FHA-insured, VA-guaranteed, and FSA/RHS-guaranteed.

columns.name: loan_type
columns.description: A numeric code for loan type, mapped to loan_type_name: 1 Conventional, 2 FHA-insured, 3 VA-guaranteed, and 4 FSA/RHS-guaranteed.

columns.name: property_type_name
columns.description: The descriptive property category; all records in this profile are One-to-four family dwelling (other than manufactured housing).
domain_values: One-to-four family dwelling (other than manufactured housing)

columns.name: property_type
columns.description: A numeric property-type code; the only observed value is 1, corresponding to property_type_name, One-to-four family dwelling (other than manufactured housing).

columns.name: loan_purpose_name
columns.description: The descriptive purpose of the loan, with observed categories Home purchase, Home improvement, and Refinancing.

columns.name: loan_purpose
columns.description: A numeric loan-purpose code mapped to loan_purpose_name: 1 Home purchase, 2 Home improvement, and 3 Refinancing.

columns.name: owner_occupancy_name
columns.description: The descriptive occupancy category; all records are labeled Owner-occupied as a principal dwelling.

columns.name: occupancy
columns.description: A numeric occupancy code; the only observed value is 1, alongside the owner-occupancy description in owner_occupancy_name.

columns.name: loan_amount
columns.description: The recorded loan amount as an integer, ranging from 1 to 10,000. The profile does not establish the unit or scale.

columns.name: preapproval_name
columns.description: The descriptive preapproval status, with observed values Preapproval was requested, Preapproval was not requested, and Not applicable.

columns.name: preapproval
columns.description: A numeric preapproval code mapped to preapproval_name: 1 requested, 2 not requested, and 3 not applicable.

columns.name: action_taken_name
columns.description: The descriptive action taken for the loan; all records in this profile are labeled Loan originated.

columns.name: action_taken_type
columns.description: A numeric action-taken code; the only observed value is 1, corresponding to Loan originated in action_taken_name.

columns.name: msamd_name
columns.description: The name of the metropolitan statistical area or metropolitan division associated with a record. It is missing for about 8.5% of records.

columns.name: msa_md
columns.description: A numeric code associated with the metropolitan statistical area or division named in msamd_name. It is missing for about 8.5% of records, matching the name column's missing share.

columns.name: state_name
columns.description: The name of the state associated with a record, with 52 distinct observed values. It is missing for about 0.12% of records.

columns.name: state_abbr
columns.description: The two-letter abbreviation for the state associated with a record, corresponding to state_name. It is missing for about 0.12% of records.

columns.name: state_code
columns.description: A numeric state identifier associated with state_name and state_abbr; observed values range from 1 to 72. It is missing for about 0.12% of records.

columns.name: county_name
columns.description: The name of the county associated with a record, with 1,622 distinct observed names. It is missing for about 0.18% of records.

columns.name: county_code
columns.description: A numeric county identifier associated with county_name, with observed values from 1 to 840. It is missing for about 0.18% of records.

columns.name: census_tract_number
columns.description: A numeric census tract identifier, with values from 1 to 9901; the profile does not indicate a unit. It is almost always populated.

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity_name
columns.description: The applicant’s ethnicity as a text label: Hispanic or Latino, Not Hispanic or Latino, Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application, or Not applicable.
domain_values: Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application

columns.name: applicant_ethnicity
columns.description: The applicant’s ethnicity encoded as an integer: 1 = Hispanic or Latino, 2 = Not Hispanic or Latino, 3 = Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application, and 4 = Not applicable; the corresponding labels are in applicant_ethnicity_name.

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity_name
columns.description: The co-applicant’s ethnicity as a text label. Values include the applicant ethnicity categories, plus No co-applicant.
domain_values: Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application

columns.name: co_applicant_ethnicity
columns.description: The co-applicant’s ethnicity encoded as an integer: 1 = Hispanic or Latino, 2 = Not Hispanic or Latino, 3 = Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application, 4 = Not applicable, and 5 = No co-applicant; labels are in co_applicant_ethnicity_name.

columns.name: applicant_race_name_1
columns.description: The applicant’s first reported race category as a text label, including American Indian or Alaska Native, Asian, Black or African American, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and White. It also includes Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application and Not applicable.
domain_values: Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application
Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

columns.name: applicant_race_1
columns.description: The applicant’s first reported race category encoded as an integer: 1 = American Indian or Alaska Native, 2 = Asian, 3 = Black or African American, 4 = Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, 5 = White, 6 = Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application, and 7 = Not applicable; labels are in applicant_race_name_1.

columns.name: applicant_race_name_2
columns.description: A text label for the applicant’s second reported race category, using the five listed race categories. This field is missing for nearly all records.
domain_values: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

columns.name: applicant_race_2
columns.description: The applicant’s second reported race category, encoded as a numeric code: 1 = American Indian or Alaska Native, 2 = Asian, 3 = Black or African American, 4 = Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and 5 = White; labels are in applicant_race_name_2. It is missing for nearly all records.

columns.name: applicant_race_name_3
columns.description: A text label for the applicant’s third reported race category, using the five listed race categories. This field is missing for nearly all records.
domain_values: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

columns.name: applicant_race_3
columns.description: The applicant’s third reported race category, encoded as a numeric code: 1 = American Indian or Alaska Native, 2 = Asian, 3 = Black or African American, 4 = Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and 5 = White; labels are in applicant_race_name_3. It is missing for nearly all records.

columns.name: applicant_race_name_4
columns.description: A text label for the applicant’s fourth reported race category; the observed labels are Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander and Asian. The field is effectively entirely missing.

columns.name: applicant_race_4
columns.description: The applicant’s fourth reported race category, encoded numerically, with observed codes 2 and 4 corresponding to Asian and Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander in applicant_race_name_4. The field is effectively entirely missing.

columns.name: applicant_race_name_5
columns.description: A text label for the applicant’s fifth reported race category; the observed labels are White and Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander. The field is effectively entirely missing.

columns.name: applicant_race_5
columns.description: The applicant’s fifth reported race category, encoded numerically, with observed codes 4 and 5 corresponding to Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander and White in applicant_race_name_5. The field is effectively entirely missing.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_name_1
columns.description: The co-applicant’s first reported race category as a text label, including the five listed race categories. It also includes Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application, Not applicable, and No co-applicant.
domain_values: Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application
Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

columns.name: co_applicant_race_1
columns.description: The co-applicant’s first reported race category encoded as an integer: 1 = American Indian or Alaska Native, 2 = Asian, 3 = Black or African American, 4 = Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, 5 = White, 6 = Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application, 7 = Not applicable, and 8 = No co-applicant; labels are in co_applicant_race_name_1.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_name_2
columns.description: A text label for the co-applicant’s second reported race category, using the five listed race categories. This field is missing for nearly all records.
domain_values: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

columns.name: co_applicant_race_2
columns.description: The co-applicant’s second reported race category, encoded as a numeric code: 1 = American Indian or Alaska Native, 2 = Asian, 3 = Black or African American, 4 = Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and 5 = White; labels are in co_applicant_race_name_2. It is missing for nearly all records.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_name_3
columns.description: A text label for the co-applicant’s third reported race category; observed labels are White, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and Black or African American. This field is missing for nearly all records.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_3
columns.description: The co-applicant’s third reported race category, encoded numerically: 3 = Black or African American, 4 = Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and 5 = White; labels are in co_applicant_race_name_3. It is missing for nearly all records.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_name_4
columns.description: A fourth co-applicant race label field. The profile reports it as entirely missing, with no observed values.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_4
columns.description: A numeric code field for the co-applicant’s fourth reported race category. The profile shows the field as entirely missing but also reports 5 as its sole frequent value, so no label mapping is available here.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_name_5
columns.description: A fifth co-applicant race label field. The profile reports it as entirely missing, with no observed values.

columns.name: co_applicant_race_5
columns.description: A numeric code field for the co-applicant’s fifth reported race category. The profile reports it as entirely missing, with no observed values.

columns.name: applicant_sex_name
columns.description: The applicant’s sex category, stored as descriptive text. Values include Male, Female, Not applicable, and information not provided by the applicant.
domain_values: Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application

columns.name: applicant_sex
columns.description: The applicant’s sex category, encoded as an integer and labeled in applicant_sex_name: 1=Male, 2=Female, 3=information not provided, and 4=Not applicable.

columns.name: co_applicant_sex_name
columns.description: The co-applicant’s sex category, stored as descriptive text. Values include Male, Female, No co-applicant, Not applicable, and information not provided by the applicant.
domain_values: Information not provided by applicant in mail, Internet, or telephone application

columns.name: co_applicant_sex
columns.description: The co-applicant’s sex category, encoded as an integer and labeled in co_applicant_sex_name: 1=Male, 2=Female, 3=information not provided, 4=Not applicable, and 5=No co-applicant.

columns.name: applicant_income
columns.description: A numeric value for applicant income. The observed values are commonly around 40–70, with a range of 1–9999; the profile does not establish a unit or the meaning of the maximum value.

columns.name: purchaser_type_name
columns.description: The purchaser category, stored as descriptive text. Values identify purchaser types such as Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Ginnie Mae, banks, and private securitization, as well as loans not originated or sold in the covered calendar year.
domain_values: Commercial bank, savings bank or savings association
Life insurance company, credit union, mortgage bank, or finance company
Loan was not originated or was not sold in calendar year covered by register

columns.name: purchaser_type
columns.description: The purchaser category, encoded as an integer and labeled in purchaser_type_name. Code 0 means the loan was not originated or was not sold in the covered calendar year; codes 1–9 identify the purchaser categories shown in that label column.

columns.name: denial_reason_name_1
columns.description: A text field for the first denial reason, but it is null in every profiled record, so no reason values can be described.

columns.name: denial_reason_1
columns.description: A field for the first denial reason, but it is null in every profiled record, so its encoding and possible values cannot be determined.

columns.name: denial_reason_name_2
columns.description: A text field for the second denial reason, but it is null in every profiled record, so no reason values can be described.

columns.name: denial_reason_2
columns.description: A field for the second denial reason, but it is null in every profiled record, so its encoding and possible values cannot be determined.

columns.name: denial_reason_name_3
columns.description: A text field for the third denial reason, but it is null in every profiled record, so no reason values can be described.

columns.name: denial_reason_3
columns.description: A field for the third denial reason, but it is null in every profiled record, so its encoding and possible values cannot be determined.

columns.name: rate_spread
columns.description: A numeric loan rate-spread value, observed from 1.5 to 20.69. It is missing for about 92% of records; the profile does not specify the unit.

columns.name: hoepa_status_name
columns.description: Indicates whether a loan is a HOEPA loan, stored as descriptive text. The observed categories are HOEPA loan and Not a HOEPA loan.

columns.name: hoepa_status
columns.description: HOEPA status encoded as an integer and labeled in hoepa_status_name: 1=HOEPA loan and 2=Not a HOEPA loan.

columns.name: lien_status_name
columns.description: Describes lien status; every profiled record is labeled Secured by a first lien.

columns.name: lien_status
columns.description: Lien status encoded as an integer and labeled in lien_status_name. The only observed code is 1, meaning Secured by a first lien.

columns.name: edit_status_name
columns.description: A descriptive quality-edit status, observed as Quality edit failure only. It is null in about 87% of records.

columns.name: edit_status
columns.description: An edit-status code labeled in edit_status_name; the only observed non-null code is 6, meaning Quality edit failure only. It is null in about 87% of records.

columns.name: sequence_number
columns.description: An integer sequence identifier for records, ranging from 1 to 1,116,761. The profile does not indicate a measurement unit.

columns.name: population
columns.description: A numeric population count, likely for the geographic area associated with the record; observed values range from 1 to 33,201. The profile does not specify the geographic unit.

columns.name: minority_population
columns.description: A numeric percentage for the minority population of the associated geographic area, observed from about 0.83 to 100. The decimal values support interpreting this as a percentage rather than a count.

columns.name: hud_median_family_income
columns.description: The HUD median family income for the associated geographic area, with observed values from 17,500 to 111,300. The values appear to be monetary amounts, but the profile does not specify a currency or time period.

columns.name: tract_to_msamd_income
columns.description: The tract’s income relative to the median family income for the associated metropolitan statistical area or metropolitan division, expressed as a percentage; values range from about 6.35 to 475.44, with 100 indicating an equal value.

columns.name: number_of_owner_occupied_units
columns.description: A numeric count of owner-occupied housing units, with observed values from 5 to 8,526. The profile shows a small share of missing values.

columns.name: number_of_1_to_4_family_units
columns.description: A numeric count of housing units in 1-to-4-family properties, with observed values from 6 to 13,227. The profile shows a small share of missing values.

columns.name: application_date_indicator
columns.description: An integer indicator field that is 0 for every record. The profile does not show any other values or establish a more specific interpretation of 0.

columns.name: date_application_received
columns.description: The date the application was received, encoded as an eight-digit YYYYMMDD integer. Observed dates range from 20100101 through 20241231.

columns.name: action_taken_date
columns.description: The date associated with the action taken on the application, encoded as an eight-digit YYYYMMDD integer. Observed dates range from 20100108 through 20241231.

columns.name: loan_number
columns.description: A numeric loan identifier; the profile shows 200,000 distinct values across 200,000 records. It is stored as an integer, and no additional encoding or unit is evident.
